source_title: Minecraft Server Keeps Crashing: Causes and Fixes
raw_log:
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: GC overhead limit exceeded
java.lang.UnsupportedClassVersionError: ... has been compiled by a more recent version of Java
Class file has wrong version 60.0, should be 52.0
[Server Watchdog/ERROR]: A single server tick took 60.00 seconds
java.net.BindException: Address already in use
fix_solution:
Out of memory fixes, in order: Add 2 GB and see if it stabilizes. Set Xms and Xmx to the same value (if start command has -Xms2G -Xmx8G, change both to 8G). Use Aikar's flags. Hunt the memory leak: install Spark and run /spark heapsummary.
Wrong Java: 1.20.5+ needs Java 21; 1.18-1.20.4 needs Java 17; 1.13-1.16.5 needs Java 8/11; install the right Java and point the server at it.
